extrahardmode.name: Extra Hard Mode
gamerule.extrahardmode.enabled.descripti: Master switch for Extra Hard Mode. Off disables every dimension; per-dimension enable is stored separately.
extrahardmode.toast.title: Extra Hard Mode
extrahardmode.toast.enabled_on: Extra Hard Mode is on. /gamerule extrahardmode:enabled
extrahardmode.toast.enabled_off: Extra Hard Mode is off. /gamerule extrahardmode:enabled
extrahardmode.command.enabled.true: Extra Hard Mode is on in %s
extrahardmode.command.enabled.false: Extra Hard Mode is off in %s
extrahardmode.command.set.failed: Failed to save Extra Hard Mode config for this dimension
extrahardmode.command.set-world: Set Extra Hard Mode for %s to %s
extrahardmode.message.stone_mining_help: You'll need an iron or diamond pickaxe to break stone. Try exploring natural formations for exposed ore like coal, which softens stone around it when broken.
extrahardmode.message.no_placing_ore_aga: Sorry, you can't place ore next to stone.
extrahardmode.message.realistic_building: You can't build while in the air.
You can't place a block directly beneath you.
extrahardmode.message.limited_torch_plac: It's too soft there to fasten a torch.
extrahardmode.message.no_torches_here: There's not enough air flow down here for permanent flames. Use another method to light your way.
extrahardmode.message.heavy_inventory: You're carrying too much weight to swim!
extrahardmode.message.zombie_slow: Zombies slow you down when hit!
extrahardmode.message.limited_end_buildi: Sorry, building here is very limited. You may only break blocks to reach ground level.
extrahardmode.message.zombie_respawn: Zombies might resurrect if not on fire!
extrahardmode.message.charged_creeper: Charged Creepers explode instantly when hit. Run!
extrahardmode.message.blaze_overworld: Blazes spawn near lava and their fiery breath causes a big explosion on death!
extrahardmode.message.blaze_nether: Blazes spawn everywhere in the Nether and may split on death!
extrahardmode.message.magmacube: These small buggers actually are just disguised blazes!
extrahardmode.message.ghast_warning: These fearsome Ghasts wear invisible arrow deflective armor! Ghasts drop a lot more loot as well.
extrahardmode.message.pigzombie: RUN! Pig Zombies are always angry and hungry!
extrahardmode.message.pigzombie_wart: You can get netherwart from slaying Pig Zombies
extrahardmode.message.skeleton_deflect_a: Arrows just pass through Skeletons, you gotta go close combat!
extrahardmode.message.creeper_drop_tnt: Creepers may drop activated tnt on death!
extrahardmode.message.extinguish_fire: Putting out fire with your hand will catch you on fire.
extrahardmode.message.bucket_fill: You can pick up water, but once you place it, it evaporates. Get some ice if you want to farm!
extrahardmode.message.antifarm_unwatered: Your crops need sufficient water, otherwise they'll dry out!
extrahardmode.message.antifarm_natural_l: Your crops require natural light to grow!
extrahardmode.message.antifarm_desert: Deserts are really dry and nothing grows here!
extrahardmode.message.animal_overcrowd: Animals need space! Consider putting them in a bigger area
extrahardmode.message.nether_warn: This is a dangerous place. Make sure you come prepared with arrows and good gear.
extrahardmode.message.lost_items: On death there is a chance you might lose some of your items!
